upcoming.title: The Courage to Choose Yourself
upcoming.subtitle: Boundaries, self-trust, and living a life that is true to you
upcoming.descriptionShort: A gathering for women ready to honour their boundaries, deepen self-trust, and live more fully in alignment with what is true to them—Gathering 3 in the Elysian House series.
upcoming.descriptionMedium:
Becoming Her asked you one question: who are you underneath all the roles and the titles? The Courage to Choose Yourself asks the next one: now that you know—what are you going to do about it?

The Courage to Choose Yourself is the third Elysian House gathering. It builds on everything we explored at Becoming Her—and goes deeper. This curated, intimate space is for women ready to stop abandoning themselves for the comfort of others and start living a life that is actually true to who she is.
upcoming.descriptionFull:
Becoming Her asked you one question: who are you underneath all the roles and the titles? The Courage to Choose Yourself asks the next one: now that you know—what are you going to do about it? Because knowing who you are is just the beginning. The real work is choosing her—every single day.

The Courage to Choose Yourself is the third Elysian House gathering. It builds on everything we explored at Becoming Her—and goes deeper. This is a curated, intimate space for women to pause, reflect, and have the honest conversations most of us avoid. No performances. No pressure. Just a room built for truth.

Through guided reflection, honest conversation, and the safe space Elysian House is known for, every woman who walks through that door will leave clearer about who she is choosing to be—and braver about living it. We explore what it means to choose yourself—not as a selfish act, but as the most responsible thing a woman can do for herself and everyone she loves.
exploreBullets: Boundaries: where you have said yes when you meant no, and what it costs to keep the peace instead of yourself
Self-trust: rebuilding the relationship with your own intuition and trusting the woman in the mirror again
Alignment: where the life you are living and the life that is true to you have drifted apart—and what it takes to bring them back
The cost of not choosing: naming out loud what it costs a woman to keep putting herself last
What she takes home: clarity, permission to choose herself, and one boundary named and ready to be honoured
upcoming.closingNote: Knowing who you are is just the beginning. The real courage is choosing her. Every single day.

past.title: Becoming Her
past.subtitle: The Woman You're Meant to Be
past.descriptionShort: After seasons of survival and healing, many women reach a moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now? This gathering is a space to pause, reflect, and reconnect with yourself.
past.descriptionMedium:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her was an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we explored identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.
past.descriptionFull:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her was an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we explored identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.

This gathering created a space for women to transform past pain into personal power and begin stepping more confidently into the next chapter of their lives.
past.experienceBlock: Women showed up with honesty about survival, healing, and identity—and left with sharper clarity on who they are becoming, strengthened self-trust, and connection with others walking the same path.

past.title: Transform and Thrive
past.subtitle: From Survival to Thriving
past.descriptionShort: The first Elysian House gathering, an intimate space for women moving from surviving toward thriving, with honesty and shared experience.
past.descriptionMedium: Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering, a curated, intimate space for women moving beyond surviving toward truly thriving. Together they built safety, honesty, and shared reflection; one room grew into a community of women choosing their lives intentionally.
past.descriptionFull:
Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering, a curated, intimate space for women ready to move beyond surviving and begin the journey of truly thriving.

Women came together in a room built on safety, honesty, and shared experience. Through guided reflection and open conversation, they began to explore what it means not only to manage their lives, but to choose them intentionally.

What started as one room became the foundation of a growing community of women finding their way home to themselves.
past.experienceBlock: Women arrived as strangers and left as a community built on honest conversations, shared stories, and presence without performance.
